title: Melanchthon and many Lutherans deny Suevic ubiquity and put multivolitional presence in its place
pass_a_gloss: But Melanchthon, Peucer, Heshusius, Hofmann himself, Chemnitz, Chytraeus, Selnecker, Major, and so on, also denied the Suevic ubiquity of Christ's flesh, together with the Reformed; and long since the Danes, Holsteiners, Brunswickers, Helmstedt men, Anhaltines, Hessians, the theologians of Lower Saxony, the Nurembergers, and so on. And, with Chemnitz leading, they substituted in place of ubiquity, or πανταχεσία, a multivolitional presence; that is, a real κοινωνία or μετοχή of the divine operations in the human nature, by which it is wherever it wills to be, and whenever it wills; or by which it can be wherever it wishes, as the Hessians in their Judgment on the Torgau Formula, A. 1567.
pass_b_english: Melanchthon, Peucer, Heshusius, Hofmann himself, Chemnitz, Chytraeus, Selnecker, Major, and others joined the Reformed in denying the Suevic ubiquity of Christ's flesh.
So did the Danes, Holsteiners, Brunswickers, Helmstedt men, Anhaltines, Hessians, the Lower-Saxon theologians, and the Nurembergers, long since.
Chemnitz led the way: instead of ubiquity — or πανταχεσία — they put a multivolitional presence.

That means a real κοινωνία or μετοχή of the divine operations in the human nature, so that it is wherever and whenever it wills to be, or can be wherever it wishes — the Hessian reading in their Judgment on the Torgau Formula (1567).
source_text: Sed & Ubiquitatem Suevicam Carnis Christi, cum Reformatis, negarunt Melanchthon, Peucerus, Heshusius, ipse Hofmannus, Chemnitius, Chytraeus, Selneccerus, Major, &c. ac pridem Dani, Holsati, Brunswicenses, Helmstadienses, Anhaltini, Hassi, inferioris Saxoniae Theologi, Norimbergenses, &c. Et, Chemnitio praeeunte, substituerunt loco Ubiquitatis, seu πανταχεσίας, Multivoli-praesentiam; Id est, κοινωνίαν vel μετοχὴν realem Divinarum Operationum in Nat. Humana, qua sit ubicunque vult esse, & quandocunque vult; vel qua possit esse ubicunque velit, ut Hassi in Judicio suo de Formula Torgensi, A. 1567.
notes: Controv. print pp. 63-64 / PDF ~164-165. Suevic ubiquity denied by Melanchthon circle + Dani/Hassi etc.; Multivoli-praesentia / pantachesia substitute; Hessi Formula Torgensis 1567. First falsehoods follow in 76.

choices.why: technical Chemnitz/Hessian substitute for absolute ubiquity
standard Latin form of Tilemann Heshusen; OCR Heshufius
